# Pixel worlds

> Ordinary UI controls with a small living pixel-art scene inside them, where the control's value drives the scene. Everything is painted in code with Canvas2D: no image files, no dependencies, no build step. MIT licensed.

Live gallery: https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app
Source: https://github.com/finktheartist/pixel-worlds

## Drop-in components

Each is one plain script that registers a custom element. Load it with a script tag. Do not rewrite or split the file.

- [Keep](https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app/keep/keep.js): password field where strength is a castle. `<keep-field>`, then read `el.value` and `el.score` (0 to 1). Fires `keep:change` when the score changes. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/pixel-worlds/blob/main/keep/README.md)
- [Round](https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app/round/round.js): loading bar that is the bar of a tavern. `<round-bar value="0">`, then `el.set(n)` with progress from 0 to 1. Fires `round:done` when the bar reaches 100%. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/pixel-worlds/blob/main/round/README.md)
- [Hoard](https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app/hoard/hoard.js): hold-to-delete button. `<hoard-button heading="..." warning="...">`, fires `hoard:delete` once when the hold completes. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/pixel-worlds/blob/main/hoard/README.md)
- [Sage](https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app/sage/sage.js): agent thinking states. `<sage-status state="thinking">`, then `el.set(state, label, detail)`. States: thinking, searching, reading, running, writing, waiting, done, failed. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/pixel-worlds/blob/main/sage/README.md)
- [Raven](https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app/raven/raven.js): send button. `<raven-send>`, set the `progress` attribute (0 to 1) from your own send or leave it off for a timed flight. Fires `raven:sent` once. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/pixel-worlds/blob/main/raven/README.md)
- [Sigil](https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app/sigil/sigil.js): loading spinner that is a summoning circle lit only by a wisp. `<sigil-spinner label="Loading">` is a plain spinner; `el.set(n)` with progress from 0 to 1 (or the `value` attribute) lights the runes, `el.set(1)` finishes, and `el.fail()` fails. Fires `sigil:done` or `sigil:fail` once. A value that stands still shows as waiting (`el.stalled`). 97 by 97 pixels, round, inline. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/pixel-worlds/blob/main/sigil/README.md)

Install any one with the shadcn CLI: `npx shadcn add finktheartist/pixel-worlds/NAME`, where NAME is keep, round, hoard, sage, raven or sigil. The file lands in `public/pixel-worlds/`.

## The skill

- [pixel-worlds skill](https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app/skills/pixel-worlds/SKILL.md): the workflow and pixel rules these were made by. Install with `npx skills add finktheartist/pixel-worlds`.
- [kit.js](https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app/skills/pixel-worlds/kit.js): the painter (layers, light, palette crush, pixel font, two-bone limbs, a clock you can stop).
- [starter.html](https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app/skills/pixel-worlds/starter.html): the smallest whole example.
- [look.mjs](https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app/skills/pixel-worlds/look.mjs): steps an animation to chosen moments and saves the frames side by side.
